integrity: Independent audit not performed. All cited primary public posting dates verified; proof and checker included as independent reproducibility materials.
scientific_limitations: Finite real metrics with disjoint short pairs of lengths strictly between 0 and 1; no overlapping pairs, degenerate pairs or general full face-vector classification. Related published equilateral and small-n cases are not claimed novel. The analytic proof supplies the universal assertion; bounded exact arithmetic checks are supplementary.
title: Facet enumeration for equilateral metrics with independently shortened pairs
